main_subject.detail: A bright 3D student-program poster with a giant title 'Shopee Sinh Vien' and a speech bubble 'MOI RA MAT'. Curved subline says 'HOC VUI HON • MUA HOI HON • TRAI NGHIEM NHIEU HON'. Two stylized 3D student avatars stand in the center, the female pointing upward and the male giving a thumbs up while holding a gold Shopee trophy cup. Large benefit blocks state 'MIEN PHI 3 THANG CANVA PRO', 'MIEN PHI 12 THANG Goi ShopeeVIP', and 'MUA SAM THA GA x4 UU DAI'. Bottom CTA says 'THAM GIA NGAY!'. Background includes a graduation cap, paper airplane, coins, discount tickets, glasses, and school-note graphics.
main_subject.style: Friendly 3D mascot-style youth poster with glossy characters, gamified rewards layout, and playful campus motifs
